purpose: Retrospective longer-window robustness check with unchanged candidates and gates; not independent confirmation after observing later discovery
selection: Discovery gate then highest worst-cost return, deterministic strategy-name tie break; validation must pass unchanged; only then inspect held-out period
capital_note: 100 USDT is a synthetic reference, not a conversion of personal capital. Allocation is a research assumption, not approved live risk.
fee_note: Current-cost counterfactual using public base USDT taker rate observed 2026-11-14; not a historical schedule or account-verified tier. Buy fees in received base, sell fees in quote. Stress doubles the fee.
limitations: Retrospective universe and window selection after later-period discovery. Excludes the known June 2025 outage. Current-cost and order-rule counterfactuals, no historical fee reconstruction, no leverage, no IRT attribution, no execution calibration or statistical significance claim. Any pass requires independent later validation and prospective evidence.
prior_observation: All baseline-v2 discovery outcomes (2025-08 through 2025-10) were already observed. This earlier-calendar extension is exploratory robustness, not independent temporal confirmation. Its strategy returns have not been evaluated at registration; original 2026 held-out returns remain uninspected.
window_rationale: Fixed calendar extension to obtain longer per-stage samples without reducing the ten-exit gate. Ends before the already documented June 2025 source gap. No performance-dependent date search or automatic gap trimming is permitted.
network_budget: At most one bounded full download per registered asset in this attempt, sequential at the existing request spacing; source failures retained and no automatic window revision.
